other_conditions: The applicant must be the registered folk artist's son or daughter
The registered folk artist must have no dues payable to the Board
The child must be studying in a government or government‑recognized institution
Assistance is available for up to two children per family
If both husband and wife are registered folk artists, only one of them is eligible for the assistance
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance of ₹1,000 to ₹10,000 for children of registered folk artists pursuing school, degree, professional, or ITI/polytechnic courses.
